text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
To her dismay, Rice Shower is unable<n>to catch up to
Mihono Bourbon at the<n>Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon approaches and<n>declares that Rice
Shower is a<n>formidable racer on the same level as
Bourbon herself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She acknowledges Rice Shower as<n>her rival and the
two vow to race<n>against one another again.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We decide to enter the Nikkei Sho so<n>that Rice
Shower's abilities can bloom<n>even more.
